To Connect the World with a Deeper, More Human Side of China.
Our vision is to help travelers discover a more personal and meaningful side of China.

Through thoughtful travel design, local connections and cultural understanding, we hope every journey becomes more than a visit. We want travel to become a bridge: between visitors and local people, between landscapes and the cultures shaped by them, and between curiosity and genuine understanding.
The best journeys do more than show you a new place. They give you a new way to understand it.

Fabio brings a cross-cultural perspective shaped by design and business education and experience in Italy.

Kashgar · Pamirs · Taklamakan Desert — A Silk Road Discovery

A 9-day private journey along the ancient Silk Road: UNESCO-listed Kashgar Old Town, the mirror-like Karakul Lake beneath Muztagh Ata, the winding Panlong Ancient Road, autumn-gold Populus euphratica forests, and the epic Taklamakan Desert Highway.

This is our flagship Southern Xinjiang itinerary — 9 days, a 7-seater business van (Mercedes V-Class or equivalent), a professional driver-guide, and 8 nights in comfortable hotels. You'll base in Kashgar, ascend the Pamir Plateau to Tashkurgan, loop back via the legendary Panlong Ancient Road, then cross the Taklamakan Desert Highway to Wensu Grand Canyon's red-sandstone landscapes, ending back in Kashgar for night markets and the Gaotai Residence. Panda Base • Siguniang • Tibetan Villages • Tagong Grassland • Kangding

A 5-day curated journey through Western Sichuan — from Chengdu's giant pandas to the sacred grasslands of Tagong, ancient Tibetan stone villages, alpine valleys and the historic Kham gateway city of Kangding.

Discover the heaven, earth, humanity and creations of Western Sichuan on this immersive 5-day route. Meet giant pandas at the tranquil Wolong Base, drive into the fairyland alpine scenery of Shuangqiao Valley, stay overnight in the stone-tower village of Zhonglu, join a Tibetan bonfire party, cross onto the Tibetan Plateau to Tagong — "The Little Lhasa of Kham" — visit the 1,300-year-old Tagong Monastery and the serene red-walled Muya Monastery, share butter tea and tsampa with a nomadic family, and end in Kangding, the historic gateway between Han and Tibetan cultures.

Descend from the plateau to Kangding, the historic 'Gateway to Kham Tibet'. Walk the old town along the Zheduo River, optionally visit Paoma Mountain Park, then return to Chengdu.
